interpretation: Existing controlled real-WebKit/native-command evidence and installed real-picker/navigation/save/cold evidence jointly support their stated Stage 1 image-preservation outcomes. Evidence levels and timing limits remain separate; they are not combined into an unobserved installed OS-read-pending result.

evidence.covers: Real Composer/WebKit image-read switch A to B, actual SQLite write refusal, explicit retry and cold read of both drafts and exact PNG.
evidence.limits: Synthetic paste/switch/quit; hidden nonpersistent WebKit and private database. No installed app, system picker, physical clipboard or Dock exit.

evidence.covers: Quit while the real File.arrayBuffer result was withheld from the product handler: no settings write or exit acknowledgement before release; one save/exit afterward and exact cold image.
evidence.limits: The actual OS read may already have completed. This proves product delivery remained pending, not OS byte-read pending. Synthetic paste/switch/quit; not the installed app.

evidence.covers: Actual first native attachment prefix-read command had not received its bytes while switching and requesting quit; release led to one save/exit and correct cold image ownership.
evidence.limits: Historical isolated fixture with synthetic chooser result/switch/quit. Held command was draft_attachment_audio_candidate; the later image command may read cached bytes. No installed GUI or Dock proof.

evidence.covers: Formal 6ce829c5 system-picker image import, navigation ownership, normal save/quit/cold reopen, explicit attachment review and exact stored image bytes.
evidence.limits: First observation already showed a prepared image. Does not establish switch or quit while reading.

evidence.covers: Formal 6ce829c5 system-picker multi-select of three images; navigation retained exact image bytes only in the owning draft.
evidence.limits: No read-pending observation or app restart in this batch.

evidence.covers: Formal 6ce829c5 system-picker import of 40 images; draft ownership and every saved image byte matched the originals.
evidence.limits: Images were already prepared at first observation. No app exit or pending-read claim.

evidence.covers: Formal 6ce829c5 system-picker import of 20 high-resolution images; navigation ownership and every stored image byte matched.
evidence.limits: No observed pending-read window, exit or new Agent request.

evidence.covers: Formal d3529ff52 retained an oversized PNG as an image, blocked sending, and preserved the same attachment when cold-reopen recheck failed.
evidence.limits: One exact oversized-image sample; no asynchronous read/switch/quit timing claim.

unchangedMechanismProof.checksPerformed: Read-only extraction and exact byte comparison; no test or runtime rerun.

exactEqualSource.scope: entire attachmentWork helper, from function attachmentWork to the next addPickedAttachments documentation marker

coveredMechanisms: Attachment result ownership remains with its original draft generation and exact live attachment member.
Saving waits for still-owned pending attachment delivery before capturing and writing the latest snapshot.
Withdrawn attachment members cannot regain write ownership from late results.
unchangedMechanismProof.notClaimed: No whole-module, whole-application or all-input equivalence beyond these explicitly compared scopes.

remainingObservation: Installed GUI switching or quitting while the OS is still reading the selected image bytes has not been directly observed. SQLite save locks do not establish this timing; they delay persistence, not the independent attachment read.
stageBoundary: This timing limitation stays explicitly untested within P01. It does not add a new stage gate, require a new delay mechanism, or reopen already-covered normal image selection, navigation, preservation and cold-recovery paths. Original P01/P02/P04 conditions and the sole plan retain authority.
